subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw add `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as a supported public config key for compaction-only reasoning control?
rationale: The patch grows the public config surface, and OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new config keys even when the implementation is otherwise repairable.

options.title: Accept after wiring and docs
options.body: Approve the key only after the PR wires it through all local compaction paths and documents valid values, precedence, and Codex-native ignored behavior.

options.title: Decline the new key
options.body: Keep compaction tied to the session/default thinking level and ask users to manage cost through existing session/model defaults.

options.title: Narrow to existing settings
options.body: Avoid a new config source by extending an existing compaction or thinking-default surface if maintainers want one source of truth.

recommendation.title: Accept after wiring and docs
recommendation.body: Approve the key only after the PR wires it through all local compaction paths and documents valid values, precedence, and Codex-native ignored behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this PR and is the clearest current reviewer for the compaction/runtime boundary decision.
